The last pass was [PR Test, Nov 6 01:10, rocm10](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/42142043380), on the same image digest (`sha256:35750c54…`) and the same aiter.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` [#48547](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48547) ([`ed61eca1`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/ed61eca15fa026b2d2358cda9f671b20b926dd13)) added `sgl_kernel/dsa/indexer_rope.cuh`, which calls `__shfl_xor_sync(0xFFFFFFFFu, …)` at line 68. It also included that header from `deepseek_v4/main_norm_rope.cuh`, and HIP's `static_assert` requires a 64-bit mask. `sgl_kernel/warp.cuh` already defines the ROCm-safe `kFullMask`. `[FACT]` The commit is between the last pass ([`3173a999`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/3173a999fe44a4916598e38d6c70864b37bf53dd)) and the first failure ([`62384de1`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/62384de1ae5e3bbd3159afd1639525b0bf39fbf9)). **Disconfirming**: none found. Note that the helper assumes 32 lanes, while AMD runs 64-lane waves.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ✅ [#48977](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48978) is not it; the fix is [#48978](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48978) (draft, open since Nov 6 22:56). It switches both masks to `warp::kFullMask`. Ping reviewers; do not open a duplicate.

details.text: `[MEDIUM]` [#41204](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41204) ([`9285994a`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/9285994accb631f8e0b04ff47f620d01814aba21)) restores `add_bos_token` for processor-owned tokenizers such as gemma-4-E2B-it.
